sentences.text:
Smt. Sudha Devi, learned counsel preferred Vakalatnama on behalf of opposite party no.2, is
taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for applicant and Smt. Sudha Devi, learned counsel for opposite party no.2 as well as learned AGA for the State.

3. Present application has been preferred with the prayer to quash the chargesheet dated 21.05.2022 and cognizance order dated 08.07.2022 along with entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.2517 of 2022 (State Vs. Dinesh and others), arising out of Case Crime No.0050 of 2021, under Section 420,
467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC, P.S.- Kotwali Nagar, District Aligarh, pending before learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, Aligarh, on the basis of compromise.

entities.text: Criminal Case No.2517 of 2022 (State Vs. Dinesh and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. At the very outset, learned counsel for applicant sought attention of the Court towards order dated 09.07.2025 passed by Coordinate Bench of this Court in Application U/S 482 No.31271 of 2024 preferred at the behest of four co-accused whereby entire proceedings of the present case i.e.
Criminal Case No.2517 of 2022 (State Vs. Dinesh and others), arising out of Case Crime No.0050 of 2021, under Section 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC along with chargesheet dated 21.05.2020 and cognizance order dated 08.07.2022 have been quashed on the ground of verification of compromise.

5. Learned counsel for applicant submitted that in the said compromise, applicant was not present and subsequently compromise was also taken place between applicant and opposite party no.2 and as such, the entire proceedings of present case may also be quashed in respect of applicant.

6. Smt. Sudha Devi, learned counsel for opposite party no.2 seconded the submissions made by learned counsel for applicant in respect of compromise taken place between applicant and opposite party no.2 on dated 06.05.2025 and submitted that opposite party no.2 has no objection if the proceedings may be quashed in light of the compromise.

7. Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for parties, this Court observes that there is no necessity to send the compromise for verification once again before the learned court concerned, since the Coordinate Bench has already quashed the entire proceedings of the case on the basis of the earlier verification report and if the compromise deed dated 06.05.2025 is sent for verification again, the outcome would remain the same.

8. In view thereof, chargesheet dated 21.05.2022 and cognizance order dated 08.07.2022 along with entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.2517 of 2022 (State Vs. Dinesh and others), arising out of Case Crime No.0050 of 2021, under Section 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC, P.S.- Kotwali Nagar,
Dinesh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124760965/
2 District Aligarh, pending before learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, Aligarh, are hereby quashed in respect of applicant also on the basis of compromise deed dated 06.05.2025.
9.

10. This order is being passed by this Court after hearing the contesting parties.
If at all, opposite party no. 2 feels that he has been duped or betrayed, then in that event, he may seek recall of this order by way of filing recall application explaining the reasons.

(Saurabh Srivastava,J.) November 7, 2025 Vivek Kr.
